ranking_note: Screening scores are the sums of the stated rubric criteria, recalculated while integrating the reviews. They compare unlike solutions and are not an adoption recommendation or definitive market ranking.

records.name: Bagisto
records.description: Modular Laravel commerce platform with marketplace features, REST API package, storefront/admin and localization tooling.

license.commercial_reuse: Commercial use/modification permitted with MIT notice retention; separately review extensions, dependencies, themes and service terms.

records.headless_api: REST admin/shop API package with Sanctum and Swagger; GraphQL reference in docs.
records.multi_vendor: Explicit project and official-site claims: seller management, commissions, product approvals, order handling and vendor dashboard. Confirm core/package boundary and release applicability.
records.arabic_rtl: Strongest candidate evidence in this batch: `ar` locale listed and official localization docs identify RTL support. Full translations and end-to-end UI behavior remain untested.
security_flags: Multiple advisories, including critical/high issues; exact patch status for selected version unknown.
records.confidence: medium; strongest RTL signal, but beta release and advisory status need attention
records.score_note: Recalculated from the nine criterion-point values in the evidence note during integration.

records.name: Medusa
records.description: Open-core headless commerce platform and TypeScript framework with modular commerce functions, workflows, providers and customizable admin.

license.spdx: MIT core; Enterprise Edition materials separately licensed
license.commercial_reuse: MIT terms apply to core files; exclude or separately license Enterprise materials and inspect dependencies.

records.headless_api: REST routes and modules consumed by storefront/admin clients; separate optional Next.js storefront.
records.multi_vendor: Marketplace is a stated use case; built-in seller tenancy/onboarding/commissions/payouts not verified.
records.arabic_rtl: Unknown; Finnish/Swedish admin translations were evidenced, not Arabic/RTL.
security_flags: Security policy and API hardening in release notes; no independent audit or full advisory/dependency review.
records.confidence: moderate for feature, architecture and dated release facts; RTL and security posture remain uncertain

records.name: Vendure
records.description: TypeScript/NestJS headless commerce framework with separate Shop/Admin GraphQL APIs, worker, plugins and SQL database support.

license.spdx: GPLv3 stated on repository; exact LICENSE file not independently read
license.commercial_reuse: Project describes a plugin exception and commercial Platform; obtain counsel's review of exact file, modifications, plugins and distribution/deployment model.

records.headless_api: Separate GraphQL Shop and Admin APIs; plugin extension points.
records.multi_vendor: Marketplace use case and Seller entity are documented; complete seller onboarding, roles, commissions and payouts are not established.
records.arabic_rtl: Localized content/channel language selection documented; Arabic UI and RTL unknown.
security_flags: Multiple 2026 high/critical advisories; v3.7.4 says it fixes two issues. Confirm exact affected/fixed versions and supported branch.
records.confidence: moderate for features and maintenance; license file and exact advisory remediation require verification

records.name: Saleor
records.description: API-only, GraphQL-only headless commerce backend with separate dashboard/storefront projects and extension mechanisms.

license.commercial_reuse: Commercial reuse/modification generally permitted subject to notices/disclaimer and endorsement restrictions; review dependencies and trademarks separately.

records.headless_api: GraphQL-only/API-only backend with webhooks, apps and API extensions.
records.multi_vendor: Unknown; channels and multiple warehouses do not establish seller tenancy.
records.arabic_rtl: Unknown; translatable catalog claim only, Arabic/RTL not verified.
security_flags: Security policy supports versions >=3.19; release notes include dependency fixes. No audit or full advisory assessment.
records.confidence: moderate for platform/license/release; database version, tests, seller model and RTL unknown

records.name: Sylius
records.description: Symfony-based modular commerce framework, headless/API-first capable with configurable channels, locales and replaceable frontend.

license.commercial_reuse: Commercial reuse subject to MIT notice retention; separately review dependencies, plugins and Sylius Plus boundaries.

records.name: Spree Commerce
records.description: Self-hostable Rails commerce platform with REST APIs/SDKs, React admin, Seller Panel and optional Next.js storefront.

license.commercial_reuse: Commercial reuse permitted subject to retaining notices/disclaimer and endorsement restrictions; review separately distributed integrations.

records.headless_api: REST Store/Admin/Seller APIs, SDKs and OpenAPI 3.0.
records.multi_vendor: Explicit open-source core claims for seller onboarding, order splitting, commissions, payout ledger/Stripe Connect and Seller Panel; validate implementation in a POC.

license.commercial_reuse: Review GPL obligations and each extension/theme separately; confirm root licensing with project before reuse.

records.name: Magento Open Source
records.description: Extensible PHP commerce application with REST, SOAP and GraphQL APIs; release-specific, service-heavy deployment requirements.

license.commercial_reuse: External deployment and derivative-work provisions are significant; repository says customer ordering terms may supersede OSL for covered files. Legal review is essential.

records.headless_api: REST, SOAP and GraphQL API surfaces; headless feasibility evidenced, not turnkey storefront readiness.
records.multi_vendor: Unknown; no native marketplace capability verified.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation dictionaries and language packages documented; Arabic completeness/RTL unverified.
security_flags: Adobe bulletin APSB26-92 (2026-08-18) reports critical/important/moderate vulnerabilities; apply fixed updates and verify exact branch.
records.confidence: moderate; license and tech facts supported, but alpha status and significant operational/security diligence
